description: PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for ROMANIAN government tenders -- procurement contract notices (anunturi de participare: CN, SCN, RFQ, PC) published in SEAP / SICAP, the national electronic public procurement system run by AADR. Returns notices newest-first within a publish-date window, optionally filtered by a title keyword (Romanian, e.g. "autostrada", "medicamente", "echipamente IT"). Each notice is shaped compact: notice number, title, contracting authority (with fiscal code), contract type (works/services/supplies), procedure type and state, CPV code, estimated value in RON, publish time and tender-receipt deadline.

days.description: Look back this many days from now (default 14, max 365). Ignored when date_from is given.

page.description: Zero-based page of `limit` results for going deeper (default 0).

query.description: Optional keyword matched against the notice title (Romanian works best, diacritics optional).

name: ro_tender_notices
